funding.value: Graduate assistantships include a monthly stipend and tuition coverage, awarded on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: Graduate Assistant Positions: All graduate assistants receive a monthly stipend, and | most cover the cost of tuition.

entry_route.value: Candidates earn not less than 60 semester hours of course credit beyond the bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: Candidates for the degree of Doctor of Philosophy with a major in mathematics will be required to earn not less than 60 semester hours of course credit beyond the bachelor's degree in mathematics and closely related fields.
